annotations.title: Draft a short AI use policy

description: Builds a short AI use policy draft in Markdown (ten sections, about two pages) from the answers to get_policy_questions: purpose, scope, approved tools, data rules (what never goes into free or unapproved AI tools), allowed and prohibited uses, human review of AI output, approval of new tools, incident reporting and a review date. It is a fixed template filled with the answers: no AI model is called, there is no network access, and this server does not store or log the answers. Only company_name is required. Every other answer left out becomes a bracketed placeholder in the draft, and after the policy the result lists them, together with any free plan or kind of data that needs a second look (show that list to the person). Ask the person for the answers, do not invent them. Optional effective_date (YYYY-MM-DD) defaults to today (UTC). The output is a draft for internal use, not legal advice.

ai_tools.description: Which AI tools does the team use or plan to use? Name the product and, if you know it, the plan.

allowed_uses.description: What may people use AI for? One use per entry.

approver.description: Who approves new AI tools and receives incident reports? A role or a name.

data_handled.description: What kinds of non-public data does the team handle? The policy already covers client confidential information, personal data and credentials; add anything else.

effective_date.description: Date the policy takes effect, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).

industry.description: What industry or kind of work is it?

prohibited_uses.description: What is off limits beyond the standard rules? One item per entry.

review_cadence.description: How often will the policy be reviewed?

name: draft_ai_use_policy

next_review_date.description: Null when review_cadence was not given.

placeholders.description: Parts of the draft still to be filled in or checked; the same list is printed after the policy in the text content.

policy_markdown.description: The policy draft alone, Markdown. The text content of the result is this draft followed by a list headed 'Still to fill in or check'.
